title: Ene Settings
description: Configuration schema for Ene application settings.json

selected_character_name.description: Name of the selected character (from charactor.json data.name)

selected_motion_path.description: Relative path to the selected VRMA motion file within the assets directory

model_scale.description: Uniform scale factor for the character model

character_position.description: 3D position of the character [x, y, z]

look_at_strength.description: Strength of the head/eye tracking toward the cursor (0.0 to 1.0)

graphics.description: Graphics and rendering quality settings. All fields have defaults.

mask_render_downsample.description: Downsample factor for mask rendering. Lower values increase quality but reduce performance.

target_fps.description: Target frames per second. 0 means unlimited.

ai.description: AI provider, model, memory, and sandbox settings. All fields have defaults.

model.description: Model identifier to use for chat completions

base_url.description: Base URL for the AI provider API

api_key.description: API key for the AI provider

user_name.description: Display name for the user in chat context

runtime_rules.description: System-level runtime behavior rules/prompting for the AI
runtime_rules.default: Keep responses relatively short and sweet, suitable for displaying on a screen overlay.

tool_calling_enabled.description: Whether AI tool calling is enabled

max_tool_call_rounds.description: Maximum number of consecutive tool call rounds allowed

mcp_servers.description: List of MCP (Model Context Protocol) server configurations

enabled.description: Whether long-term memory (embedding-based recall) is enabled

db_path.description: Path to the SQLite memory database. If empty, derived from character card location.

embedding_provider_type.description: Type of embedding provider to use

embedding_model.description: Model identifier for text embeddings. For local provider: 'jina-embeddings-v5-text-small'. For API provider: 'text-embedding-3-small', etc.

embedding_base_url.description: Base URL for the embedding provider. Falls back to the main base_url if empty. Only used when embedding_provider_type is 'api'.

embedding_dimensions.description: Dimensionality of embedding vectors. Omit or null for auto-detection (local provider). For API provider: 1536 for text-embedding-3-small.

gguf_quantization.description: GGUF quantization level for the local embedding model. Smaller files use less disk/memory but may reduce quality. F16 offers highest quality.

recall_limit.description: Maximum number of memory entries to recall per query

similarity_threshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity threshold for recalling memories

time_decay_hours.description: Time decay factor in hours for memory recency scoring

similarity_weight.description: Weight given to similarity score in memory ranking (0.0 to 1.0)

recency_weight.description: Weight given to recency score in memory ranking (0.0 to 1.0)

auto_session_split.description: Automatically split sessions when topic changes or timeout occurs

session_timeout_minutes.description: Minutes of inactivity before automatic session split

topic_change_threshold.description: Embedding similarity threshold (0.0-1.0) below which a topic change is detected and session is split. Higher values = more aggressive splitting.

min_turns_before_split.description: Minimum conversation turns before a session can be split (prevents splitting very short conversations)

summary_recall_limit.description: Maximum number of past conversation summaries injected into the system prompt

summarization_model.description: Model for conversation summarization. Empty string uses the main chat model.

summarization_base_url.description: Base URL for summarization API. Empty string uses the main base_url.

screenshot_scale_percent.description: Percentage scale for screenshots taken by the AI tool (1-100)

sandbox.description: Sandbox permission and resource limit settings for file/shell tools

enabled.description: Whether the sandbox permission system is enabled for file/shell tools

allowed_directories.description: List of directories the AI is allowed to read from

writable_directories.description: List of directories the AI is allowed to write to

blocked_commands.description: List of regex patterns for shell commands that are blocked

max_read_bytes.description: Maximum bytes allowed for a single read operation

max_write_bytes.description: Maximum bytes allowed for a single write operation

shell_timeout_ms.description: Maximum duration in milliseconds for a shell command execution

max_shell_output_bytes.description: Maximum bytes of shell command output to retain

max_shell_output_lines.description: Maximum lines of shell command output to retain

tools.description: Tool binary selection and per-tool configuration

enabled.description: List of tool names to enable (built-in: fs, web, browser, utility, app; plus any custom tools)

configs.description: Per-tool configuration (tool_name → arbitrary JSON). Each tool defines its own expected schema.

additionalProperties.description: Arbitrary JSON value passed directly to the tool's set_config()

McpServerConfig.description: Configuration for a single MCP server

name.description: Display name of the MCP server

enabled.description: Whether this MCP server is enabled

McpTransport.description: Transport method for communicating with an MCP server

url.description: HTTP endpoint URL for the MCP server
